messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "babies monitored for slow heartbeat and unusual sleepiness"
set: ["babies monitored for slow heartbeat and unusual sleepiness", "carefully observe infants for increased sleepiness", "use in child must be decided and monitored by specialist", "carefully observe infants for increased sleepiness (more than usual)", "child should be monitored during treatment", "tell healthcare provider about muscle cramps, unusual weakness or tiredness, or irregular heartbeat", "babies are watched after birth", "closely monitored for worsening mood or new or worsening suicidal thoughts", "stop taking and call doctor right away if unusual changes in mood or behavior", "tell doctor if you develop fast or irregular heartbeat", "consult healthcare provider for right treatment and support", "notify doctor if nursing baby has slow weight gain", "avoid other drugs that cause drowsiness or slow breathing", "call your doctor if they are an unusual color", "oral administration recommended for patients 12 years and older", "seek attention if you have slow breathing with long pauses"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
